author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕುಟಿಲತನವಿಲ್ಲದಿರೆ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯವುಳಿಯುವುದು
ತಟವಟವು ನಿನಗಿರಲು ಬಂಧುಗಳು ದೂರ
ಸಟೆಯಿರದ ನಡತೆಯಿರೆ ಜನರುಜತೆ ಸೇರುವರು
ದಿಟದನಡೆ ನಿನದಿರಲಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: if you are two-faced, relatives stay away;
when your conduct has no falsehood, people come together with you;
let your walk be true, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Relationships last where there is no guile. Two-faced behaviour drives people away; honesty draws them near.
